summary: The 2026 LLM landscape is dominated by a handful of proprietary flagship families (OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini) distributed widely through cloud aggregators like AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, and Snowflake Cortex, which drive the bulk of enterprise adoption. Open-weight models from DeepSeek, Meta, Mistral, and Qwen continue to see heavy HuggingFace download volume and self-hosted deployment. Because the live research data only confirms a subset of exact current model names, I have ranked only models whose current availability and naming can be verified or are well-established as publicly released, omitting speculative or unconfirmed version numbers.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.popularity_notes: Remains the most widely integrated general-purpose model across developer apps and is available through Azure OpenAI and multiple aggregators, giving it massive enterprise reach.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.popularity_notes: The default workhorse for coding and agentic workloads among developers, available via Anthropic API, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Snowflake Cortex.
models.best_for: Software development and agentic coding tasks

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.popularity_notes: High-volume, cost-efficient model consumed heavily through Google Vertex AI and the Gemini API, with strong enterprise adoption via Google Cloud.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.popularity_notes: Google's flagship reasoning model with wide distribution through Vertex AI, popular for complex reasoning and long-context enterprise tasks.

models.name: DeepSeek V3
models.popularity_notes: The most downloaded open-weight flagship on HuggingFace, widely self-hosted and served by many aggregators at low cost.

models.name: DeepSeek R1
models.popularity_notes: Leading open-weight reasoning model with enormous HuggingFace download volume and availability through multiple inference providers and aggregators.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B
models.popularity_notes: One of the most downloaded open models on HuggingFace and broadly available through AWS Bedrock, Azure, Google Vertex AI, and IBM watsonx.

models.name: o3
models.popularity_notes: OpenAI's premier reasoning model widely used for complex agentic and analytical tasks, available via OpenAI API and Azure OpenAI.
models.best_for: Advanced reasoning and complex problem solving

models.name: Mistral Large 2
models.popularity_notes: Popular European flagship available through Azure, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and IBM watsonx, favored for data-sovereignty-conscious enterprises.

models.name: Qwen3-235B-A22B
models.popularity_notes: Alibaba's flagship open-weight MoE model with very high HuggingFace downloads and growing adoption across inference aggregators.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.popularity_notes: Fast, low-cost Claude variant with strong adoption for high-volume tasks, available via Anthropic API, AWS Bedrock, and Google Vertex AI.
